scientific_limitations: Complex Veronese varieties in the standard projective embedding.
The theorem concerns the gcd of the complete polar vector, not arbitrary subcollections.
The conclusion uses the standard projective polar-degree convention.
Because the proof is short after the explicit polar formula, an unindexed older source could contain the same gcd consequence.
